parameters.note: American Lake is a high alpine lake in the Desolation Wilderness (El Dorado Co.). Although it sits within the greater Desolation/Tahoe region, it lies west of the Sierra Crest and drains via the Pyramid Creek lake chain into the South Fork American River (Sacramento River watershed), not into Lake Tahoe — so it is not a Lake Tahoe tributary and the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152)) does not apply. American Lake is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
